items.content: Fix Dockerfile FastCAS SDK stage (pinned tarball) and build args (GOPROXY, APK_MIRROR)
Build fasttask:local image via docker compose build
Stage production data at /root/dockerData/fasttask, verify migration 8→10 on a copy
Migrate live data dir, start container, verify health/auth/notification API/frontend bundle
Rebuild image after removing unused /var/backups and recreate the running container
Document Docker deployment in README.md and doc/tech.md §21.5
Final production verification against the recreated container
Commit and push Docker migration to origin/main
